title: Education
conflict: Someone else changed this a moment ago. The latest version is shown; make your change again.
no_manage: Only people who manage education here can change this.
required: Fill this in to go on.

overview.title: Education
overview.text: Students, sections and what is waiting, for the session you pick.
overview.levels_text: How full each class is across its sections.
overview.unplaced_title_one: {count} student is not in a section
overview.unplaced_title_other: {count} students are not in a section
overview.unplaced_text: Open the students list and place them, so teachers see them in their rosters.
overview.no_sections_text: Make the sections students study in (Section A, Batch 1…) for this session.
overview.no_session_text: Students are placed in a session (the year, or a semester of it). Add the year and its sessions.

wizard.title: Set up education
wizard.text: Two short steps: what kind of institution this is, then the academic year. Everything stays editable later.
wizard.preset_hint: Picks ready programs, classes, subjects and lists. You can apply a second one later (a school with a college section).
wizard.skip: I will set it up by hand
wizard.sessions_text: Each kind of program used here gets its sessions. Change the dates if they differ.
wizard.manual_hint: Without a ready preset, add programs and their classes on the structure page.
wizard.waiting_title: Education is not set up yet
wizard.waiting_text: Someone who manages education here needs to set up the programs and the academic year first.

students.title: Students
students.text: Everyone studying here and at the campuses below.
students.search: Search by name, code or phone
students.empty_text: Add the first student, or bring them in from a spreadsheet.
students.none_text: Try another name, code or phone, or clear the filters.

student.not_found: This student is not here, or you cannot see them.
student.photo_hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {kb} KB.
student.photo_too_big: This photo is larger than {kb} KB. Choose a smaller one.
student.sensitive_hidden: Private details are hidden for you.

fields.name: Full name
fields.name_hint: As in the birth registration, in English letters.
fields.admission_no_hint: Your own number from the register, if you keep one.

new_student.title: New student
new_student.code_hint: The student code is given when you save.
new_student.guardians_text: Parents or others to call. A phone already here links the same guardian (siblings share parents).
new_student.no_guardians: No guardian yet. You can add them later too.
new_student.place_text: Where the student studies now. Leave the section empty to place them later.

guardian.title: Guardian
guardian.name: Name
guardian.phone_hint: If this number is already here, that guardian is linked.
guardian.remove_text: The guardian stays linked to their other children. You can add them again.
guardian.empty_text: Add a parent or another person to call.
guardian.need_one: Add a name or a phone.

leave.title: Mark {name} as left
leave.reason_hint: Kept in the record (transfer, moved away, completed…).
leave.confirm_text: They leave their section today. The record stays and can be read later.

place.title: Move {name}
place.text: Sections of the same class in this session.
place.no_sections: There is no other section of this class in this session.

sections.title: Sections
sections.text: Sections of each class in a session, how full they are and who teaches them.
sections.empty_text: Make the first section of a class.

section.not_found: This section is not here, or it is not one of yours.
section.empty_text: Place students from their profile or when admitting them.
section.number_text: Every student here gets a roll in the order the institution uses (by name, by admission…). Rolls already given change.

structure.title: Programs, classes and sessions
structure.text: How this institution is organised. Entries in use are switched off, never deleted.
structure.programs_empty_text: Use a ready preset, or add a program (Secondary, BBA…) and its classes.
structure.years_empty_text: Add the year and its sessions; students are placed in a session.
structure.batches_empty_text: Universities and coaching centres group students who started together (Batch 2026).

form.name: Name
form.code_hint: Short, in English letters or digits (SEC, BBA, C6).
form.level_label: What a class is called here
form.level_label_hint: Class, Semester, Year… Left empty: Class.
form.section_label: What a section is called here
form.section_label_hint: Section, Batch, Group… Left empty: Section.
form.key_hint: Fixed once made; used in imports (lower-case letters, digits, _).
form.class_teacher_hrm: Turn on HR to choose class teachers from the staff.

fields_page.title: Own fields
fields_page.text: Extra details this institution asks for: on students, guardians and applications. Fields are switched off, never removed.
fields_page.empty_text: Add what your forms ask for that is not built in (blood group, previous school…).
fields_page.label: Label
fields_page.key_hint: Used in spreadsheets and exports. Fixed once made.
fields_page.portal_switch: Guardians and students see it in the portal
fields_page.documents_switch: Printed on ID cards and certificates
fields_page.sensitive_switch: Private (only people allowed to see private details)

admissions.title: Admissions
admissions.text: Applications from the office, the website and Customers, through their decisions to admission.
admissions.search: Search by number, name or phone
admissions.empty_text: Add an application when someone asks for a seat; admit them when they are accepted.
admissions.none_text: Try another name, number or phone, or another status.

admission.not_found: This application is not here, or you cannot see it.
admission.step_note_hint: Kept with the application (test date, reason…).
admission.reject_text: The application is closed. It stays in the list and can be read later.
admission.withdraw_title: Mark the application of {name} as withdrawn?
admission.place_needed: Choose the program, class and session first (Change application).

application_form.title: New application
application_form.number_hint: The application number is given when you save.

admit_dialog.title: Admit {name}
admit_dialog.text: The student, their guardians and their place in {level} are made now; their student code is given.

promotions.title: Promotion
promotions.text: Move a class to the next session: who goes up, who repeats, who leaves, and into which section.
promotions.empty_text: At the end of a session, make a list for each class and decide for every student.
promotions.no_access: You can see promotion lists when you may make or approve them.

new_promotion.title: New promotion list
new_promotion.text: Every student studying in this class (or section) now is on the list, promoted to the next class unless you change it.

promotion.not_found: This list is not here, or you cannot see it.
promotion.place_all_hint: Students who go up or repeat get this section next session.
promotion.unsaved: You have changes not saved yet.
promotion.submit_text_approval: Someone allowed to approve promotions checks it; nothing changes until they approve.
promotion.submit_text_apply: {count} students move to next session now. You can undo it for {days} days while nothing has moved on since.
promotion.approve_text: {count} students move to the next session now.
promotion.cancel_text: Nothing is changed for the students. A new list can be made.
promotion.undo_text: The next session places made by this list are removed and the students are back where they were.
promotion.own_list: You made this list, so someone else has to approve it.
promotion.read_only: This list can no longer be changed.

import.title: Import students
import.text: Bring many students from a spreadsheet at once. The file is read here, in your browser; it is never stored.
import.section: Section (when the file has no "section" column)
import.section_from_file: From the file, or place later
import.sample_hint: Save your spreadsheet as CSV (comma or semicolon). The first row holds the column names below.
import.too_many: Only the first {max} rows are taken. Split the file for more.
import.no_name: The file has no "name" column. Download the sample to see the column names.
import.empty: No rows were found in this file.
import.commit_text: Rows with problems and students already here are left out. Rows already made are never made twice.
import.no_access: Importing students needs the permission to admit them.
